verdict.rationale: Skyfire's MCP server docs list a dedicated sandbox endpoint (https://mcp-sandbox.skyfire.xyz/mcp) alongside production, so a separate test environment is a documented first-party capability. The evidence is a single parenthetical mention. Nothing describes what the sandbox covers or how it is kept apart from real wallets and settlement. The Playground and the pre-funded wallet are not described as non-production, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: a sandbox REST API base URL, test-mode API keys or test funds, documentation of data and settlement isolation from production, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the sandbox works.
